title: Correct final expression
description: Essential: The response must provide the final algebraic expression for Jupiter's mass: M = (4π²r³)/(GT²).

title: Apply Newton's law
description: Important: The solution must set the gravitational force (GMm/r²) equal to the required centripetal force (mω²r or mv²/r).

title: Express angular speed
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the orbital period T to the angular speed ω (ω = 2π/T) or linear speed v (v = 2πr/T).

title: Cancel moon's mass
description: Important: The solution must correctly cancel the mass of the moon (m) from the force balance equation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The response may include a verification that the derived expression has the correct units for mass (kg).

title: Incorrect force expression
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect expression for gravitational force (e.g., omitting G or r²) or centripetal force (e.g., mωr instead of mω²r).

title: Algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Making an algebraic mistake when solving for M, such as incorrect exponent handling or misplacing π.
